headline.title: Parallel Web Systems hits $2B valuation five months after its last big raise
headline.summary: Parallel Web Systems, an AI agent-tool startup founded by former Twitter CEO Parag Agrawal, has achieved a $2 billion valuation following a new $100 million funding round led by Sequoia. This latest investment comes just five months after the company raised an identical amount in its previous funding round.

articles.title: Is AI video just a prequel? Runway’s CEO thinks world models are next
articles.summary: Runway's CEO suggests that AI-generated video is just the beginning, with a focus on developing advanced world models next. The company has raised nearly $860 million, achieving a valuation of $5.3 billion, and competes with major players like Google and OpenAI in the AI space.

articles.title: All the evidence unveiled so far in Musk v. Altman
articles.summary: The Musk v. Altman trial is currently in progress, with evidence including email exchanges, photos, and corporate documents from the early days of OpenAI being presented in court. Key insights from the evidence reveal details from the organization's inception and its development prior to being officially named.

articles.title: Granite 4.1 LLMs: How They’re Built
articles.summary: The article discusses the architecture and development process of Granite 4.1 large language models (LLMs), detailing the techniques used to enhance their performance and capabilities. It also explores the implications of these advancements for various applications in natural language processing.

articles.title: Ubuntu’s AI plans have Linux users looking for a ‘kill switch’
articles.summary: Canonical's announcement of integrating AI features into Ubuntu has prompted some Linux users to seek alternatives, including versions without these features or switching to different distributions altogether. This response highlights a divide within the community regarding the adoption of AI technologies in the operating system.

articles.title: Google Photos uses AI to make the iconic closet from ‘Clueless’ a reality
articles.summary: Google Photos has introduced a new AI feature that automatically generates a digital copy of users' wardrobes based on clothing items identified in their photo library. This innovation aims to help users manage and organize their clothing collections more efficiently.

articles.title: Firestorm Labs raises $82M to take drone factories into the field
articles.summary: Firestorm Labs has secured $82 million in funding to develop mobile drone factories housed in shipping containers, aimed at enhancing on-site manufacturing capabilities for defense applications. This innovative approach seeks to bring production directly to the front lines.

articles.title: Google Photos launches an AI try-on feature for clothes you already have
articles.summary: Google Photos has introduced an AI feature that allows users to virtually try on clothes they already own by creating a digital "wardrobe" from their photo gallery. This tool enables users to mix and match outfits, save preferred looks, and share them with friends.

articles.title: Live updates from Elon Musk and Sam Altman’s court battle over the future of OpenAI
articles.summary: Elon Musk and Sam Altman are currently engaged in a court battle regarding the direction of OpenAI, with Musk accusing the organization of straying from its original mission to prioritize profit. The trial, which began recently, could have significant implications for OpenAI and its flagship product, ChatGPT.

articles.title: ChatGPT downloads are slowing — and may cause problems for OpenAI’s IPO
articles.summary: ChatGPT is facing a decline in user growth, with a 132% increase in app uninstalls year-over-year in April and a staggering 413% rise in June. This trend may pose challenges for OpenAI as it prepares for its initial public offering (IPO).

articles.title: Larry’s risky business
articles.summary: Oracle is shifting its focus to AI, diverging from traditional foundation model development to integrate AI capabilities into its database services. The company's performance may provide insights into the current state of the AI market and whether the anticipated AI bubble is deflating.

articles.title: Meet Shapes, the app bringing humans and AI into the same group chats
articles.summary: Shapes is a new app that integrates AI characters into group chats, allowing users to interact with both humans and AI in a shared space. The platform aims to enhance communication by blending traditional chat features with AI-driven interactions.
